subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): skip malformed legacy import-run files in doctor

question: Should malformed or schema-invalid legacy import-run files remain in place for manual recovery, or should doctor quarantine/archive them after warning?
rationale: Both choices affect the upgrade contract: retention preserves potentially recoverable user data but repeats warnings, while quarantine makes migration converge but moves data that doctor could not validate.

options.title: Retain with warning
options.body: Leave invalid files untouched, warn with the exact path, and require the user to inspect or delete them before the warning clears.

options.title: Quarantine invalid files
options.body: Move rejected files into a clearly named recovery location so doctor converges without deleting potentially recoverable data.

recommendation.title: Retain with warning
recommendation.body: Leave invalid files untouched, warn with the exact path, and require the user to inspect or delete them before the warning clears.

likelyOwner.reason: The identified history owner introduced the SQLite migration and its archive policy.
